doc.description:
This module is for the course AE4317 Autonomous Flight of Micro Air Vehicles at the TU Delft. This module combines optic flow navigation with an orange color detection failsafe.
The primary avoidance strategy uses optic flow average limits. As a failsafe, it simultaneously counts the total number of orange pixels using cv_detect_color_object. If EITHER the optic flow detects an obstacle OR the orange pixel count crosses the percentage threshold (oa_color_count_frac), the drone assumes an obstacle is ahead and executes an avoidance turn.
Requires binding to two separate ABI messages: one for Optic Flow and one for Color Detection.

define.name: OPTIC_FLOW_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID
define.description: Which VISUAL_DETECTION message to receive for optic flow calculation.

define.name: ORANGE_AVOIDER_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID
define.description: Which VISUAL_DETECTION message to receive for the orange pixel detection failsafe.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_FLOW_LPF_ENABLE
define.description: Enable (1) or disable (0) low-pass filtering of received avg_flow.

define.name: MOTION_GROUP13_FLOW_LPF_ALPHA
define.description: LPF alpha in [0..1] for avg_flow. Lower is smoother, higher is more responsive.
